description: This file contains unit tests for the CandidateStatusAPI class within the OrangeHRM Recruitment plugin. It tests API methods related to candidate status management, including retrieving all candidate statuses and verifies that create, delete, and validation rule methods are not implemented.

classes.name: CandidateStatusAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for CandidateStatusAPI, testing retrieval of candidate statuses and verifying unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all candidate statuses via the API, using data provider for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testGetAll method by loading test case data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the create method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rule method for creation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rule method for delete throws a not implemented exception.
